table_s12_heterogeneous_plants.description: Closed-loop damping characteristics of ten heterogeneous plants at baseline gain Kp_star = 100.

table_s13_matrix_structure.source: Table S13 and Section 9.1, page 22 of the supplementary PDF
notes: Each plant has per-roller arrays R_i, J_i, f_i, L_i, b_i of length 3, while EA is scalar.
For v0 = 0.01 m/s and L approximately 1 m, transport-mode eigenvalues are approximately -0.01 1/s.
Friction-tension coupling modes scale with f/J approximately 10-40 1/s.

L_m.status: Used as nominal until exact per-span arrays are supplied

section_7_1_controller.source: Section 7.1, page 16 of the supplementary PDF
notes: Cascade PI architecture uses an outer PI controller on tension error and an inner P controller on velocity.
Kp_star sweep uses {50, 100, 200}; Kp_star = 100 is the noise-free sweet spot and Kp_star = 200 is preferred under sensor noise.
